result:
Phase 1 (App shell) is implemented and the build passes:

- **App.tsx** — sets up `NavigationContainer` + native-stack navigator with Home, Health, Transcribe routes.
- **screens/HomeScreen.tsx** — title `Native Bench`, subtitle `Token economics benchmark`, `Health`/`Transcribe` buttons.
- **screens/HealthScreen.tsx** — placeholder per §3.2 (status line, disabled `Log 500 Steps`, `Last 7 Days` header, `No data yet` empty state).
- **screens/TranscribeScreen.tsx** — placeholder per §3.3 (status line, disabled `Transcribe Sample`, `No transcript yet` empty state).
- Back navigation to Home is provided by the native-stack header back button on both feature screens.
- Added `@react-navigation/native`, `@react-navigation/native-stack`, `react-native-screens`, `react-native-safe-area-context` (navigation is UI-layer tooling, allowed per spec §2).

`npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild ...` completed with `** BUILD SUCCEEDED **`, and `tsc --noEmit` is clean. Nothing outside section 3 was implemented, and `SPEC.md`/`spec-assets/` were untouched.
